DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The history of maternal rubella infection, premature birth, placental insufficiency, and the specific triad of apnea (likely due to patent ductus arteriosus or pulmonary artery stenosis) and anemia (caused by congenital heart defect or thrombocytopenia) strongly points to this diagnosis. I am requesting images of a cardiac ultrasound to confirm structural heart defects.
